description: This file defines SQLAlchemy ORM models for a gym management system, including classes for exercises, workout templates, program days, and related entities.

classes.name: Exercise
classes.description: Represents a gym exercise with attributes like name, description, category, and trainer ID.

classes.name: WorkoutTemplate
classes.description: Represents a workout template containing a name, goal, trainer ID, and associated exercises.

classes.name: TemplateExercise
classes.description: Associates exercises with workout templates, including sets, reps, rest, and notes.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Represents a training program for a member, including name, member ID, trainer ID, notes, and associated days.

classes.name: ProgramDay
classes.description: Represents a specific day within a program, including day index, name, and associated exercises.

classes.name: ProgramDayExercise
classes.description: Associates exercises with a specific program day, including sets, reps, rest, and notes.
